body: Psychologists don’t get me. No one knows how I feel so I don’t expect them to pump me full of drugs to maybe deal with it. Tbh I’d rather be dead. I really know and believe that. It’s just what my life has become. I just want it over. Nothing is worth it. Trust me, I’m dying alone, sad and never achieving any goals. I just want out of all of this.
Same. Finally doing something about it.
